trial_summary.population: patients with pulmonary embolism (PE) and venous thrombosis
trial_summary.interventions: anticoagulant treatment, with or without a retrievable vena cava filter
trial_summary.primary_outcome_summary: rate of recurrent venous thromboembolism (VTE) was low in both groups and did not differ between groups

systematic_review_meta_analysis.mortality_findings: neither all-cause mortality nor PE-related mortality differed between patients with or without filter placement

indications_for_filter_placement.broad_indication: patients with recent (<1 month) proximal DVT and an absolute contraindication to anticoagulant treatment
indications_for_filter_placement.rationale: perceived high risk of recurrent PE in this setting and lack of other treatment options

examples_of_major_interventions: endovascular retrieval of the permanent filter
other_reported_complications: deep vein thrombosis (DVT) occasionally extending up to the vena cava
